theme: A travel day — Tampa to Maine.
greeting: You fly out of Tampa at midday and land in Portland this afternoon, Dan. It's quiet otherwise — good room to clear a couple of overdue bookings before the early call tomorrow.

needsAttention.title: Hold the Maine Christmas SUV
needsAttention.detail: A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out early; your p1 task on the Mike + Dan board calls for a refundable hold now, and it's been open since mid-September. The Pathfinder heads south this month, so it's the only six-seater for the girls' Maine Christmas.

needsAttention.title: Lock the December trip
needsAttention.detail: The Dec 13–Jan 2 trip with all four girls needs a destination decided and booked by Oct 15 — the decision itself was due Sept 30. Routine passports land in November, so the note on the task leans domestic unless you go refundable.

needsAttention.title: Pathfinder drive south
needsAttention.detail: The Oct 5–18 window to drive the Pathfinder from Portland down to St Pete opens today, and you land in Portland this afternoon. Open question on the task is where the car sits the weeks you're not in Florida.

schedule.title: Flight to Portland
schedule.detail: MX 1004 out of Tampa TPA, lands around 4:55 PM.

flagged.title: Apple reports a new sign-in
flagged.detail: An email to dan@konigsburg.com says a new device signed into your Apple account and threatens AppleCare One coverage — worth confirming it's genuine before clicking anything.

flagged.title: NACD Maine Visionaries push
flagged.detail: On the NACD New England thread, the group's asked to share the Oct 28 event with their networks; Josh Broder notes he's reached out to 25 more people.

inbox.noise: A Wildgrain reorder notice, a Google Play receipt, a Substack follow, and an Evite round out the unread inbox.

recipe.title: Fricassée of chanterelles
recipe.why: Autumn is peak chanterelle season, when wild mushrooms are at their earthy best.

tasks.title: Get 3 term life quotes for Mike
Portland house order — bedframe + shower soap holder

acts.line: The morning is yours before the 12:20 flight out of Tampa — a clear stretch to clear a booking or two.
You're in the air on MX 1004, landing in Portland late afternoon.
Maine tonight, with an early 7 AM Teams call with the Valoris team first thing tomorrow.
